select ' DEPOSIT_FACT',count(*),as_of_date from eds. DEPOSIT_FACT group by as_of_date ORDER BY as_of_date

select count(*) aa from (
select count(*) a,acid from D360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL group by acid having count(*)>1
) aaa

create table d360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL_copy 

WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(ACID)
,    HEAP
)
as
select * from (
select *, row_number() over (partition by acid order by acid) rn from d360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL 
) a where rn=1 



select count(*) aa from (
select count(*) a,acid from D360.STG_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCESFULL group by acid having count(*)>1
) aaa
truncate table eds.DEPOSIT_FACT
select count(*) aa from (
select count(*) b,as_of_date,gam_acid from eds. DEPOSIT_FACT where as_of_date='2024-01-25' group by as_of_date,gam_acid  having count(*)>1
) a
